name: hovercard4
title: Blog Post Card
description: A dark blog post card pairing a close-up plant photo with a publish date, a two-line headline that underlines on hover, and a green Read Story button whose arrow doubles.
use: A blog index or news feed needs compact post teasers with a clear read link.
avoid: The demo hardcodes one post and its Unsplash photo, so a real feed needs the data wired in.
a11y: The photo's alt text says 'shoes' though it shows a plant, and hover-only cues ignore prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark card topped by a close-up photo of a tall green plant in a wild meadow. Below, a small grey date line sits above a two-line white headline and a rounded green 'Read Story' button with a chevron.
behaves: On hover the photo brightens and eases from a slight zoom to full size, the headline gains an underline, and the button arrow slides down into a double chevron as the button widens slightly.
customise: The photo URL, date, headline and link text are hardcoded; the green button colour and sizing need a source edit. No props.
weight: light: One image and CSS transitions on scale, brightness, underline and icon.
demo: Date '9 Dec 2023'; headline 'Why good UX matters, and how to get it right on your site'.
issues: Alt text 'shoes' does not match the plant photo.
The headline underline and arrow change are hover-only, with no focus equivalent.
polishWhy: Clean typographic card; generic layout and mismatched alt text keep it ordinary.
